title: City of Concord announces spring cleaning at local cemeteries starting March 23 - Cabarrus Today
text:
The City of Concord Buildings and Grounds Department announced on March 18 that annual spring cleaning at Oakwood Cemetery, Rutherford Memorial Cemetery, and West Concord Cemetery will begin Monday, March 23. The work is expected to take about one week to complete.
Residents are asked to remove any items placed on or near gravesites before March 23 to allow for mowing and grounds maintenance. According to the city, “Any item not removed from gravesites before this time will be discarded. Flowers and decorations may be replaced beginning Monday, March 30.” Notices regarding the cleanup have also been posted at each cemetery location.
The City of Concord operates a range of facilities including an airport and several fire stations, according to the official website. In addition, the city provides services such as utility management, emergency response, and infrastructure maintenance as reported by the official website.
For more information about the cemetery cleanup or related questions, residents can contact the City of Concord Buildings and Grounds Department’s Cemetery Division at 704-920-6380.
This annual effort is part of ongoing maintenance activities aimed at keeping public spaces clean and accessible for all visitors.
